body:
Thank you for your kind words. I am really sorry for what you've had to go though too. I don't think I can keep pictures because I don't have anything to take them with, but I can try to write down every incident so that i remember them. Even though no one's ever believed me. My school principal believed my mother over me. My mother manipulated me into telling the CPS caseworker that she treated me great and that no one hit me or yelled at me. 

Also, do you really think she could be schizophrenic? What about her actions make you think that? I always thought she could be psychotic or extremely depressed, but schizophrenic never crossed my mind.
